## 4. Fusion validation (**SYNTHETIC modality outputs**, strengths are assumptions; verifies logic, not real-world accuracy)

- Fused accuracy on clean/dropout samples: **0.865** vs best single modality 0.741
- Accuracy when answered as *confident*: **0.961** (coverage 0.50); when flagged: 0.673
- Share of samples flagged (not 'confident') by scenario: blend 0.64, clean 0.37, dropout 0.55, incongruent 0.80
- Tuned thresholds: `{'conf_p': 0.65, 'margin': 0.1, 'entropy': 0.7, 'conflict_jsd': 0.3, 'compat_dist': 0.75}`
